I think we will send the Statement to the Shia with a request that, if the facts of the case are as stated, he will kindly take the Shia's manumission papers from Sayyid Leid.
I think we will send the Statement to the Shares with a request that, if the facts of the case are as stated, we will kindly take the Shares' manumission papers from Laypied Leeds and send them to us for delivery to her.
